turns.text: Accounts payable reviews a vendor invoice, saves the PDF in Box and logs vendor, invoice number, date, entity and amount in Excel. We search for duplicates by vendor, invoice number and amount before recording it in Entrilia. Only a manager-reviewed, client-approved invoice is sent to Treasury under MC-07.
What does the manager review on the invoice before it is sent for client approval?

The manager checks the invoice log, Entrilia record, amount, coding, result of the duplicate check and whether the package is complete. We resolve comments, send the exact batch using the approved email or Adobe e-sign method, and retain the client's approval identifying each invoice and the total. The vendor, amount, entity and approval must match when AP hands off to Treasury. New or changed bank details are flagged for callback and screening.
When a client comments on or rejects an invoice package, what happens to it before it can be approved?

Any invoice under query or rejected must stay out of the approved batch and payment run. Resolve comments against the invoice and its support, retain the exact client-approved invoices and total, and then release just those items to MC-07. I can't give a universal cycle, deadline or urgent approver; the relevant authorizations have to be documented. The retained PDF, invoice log, Entrilia, payment log and bank evidence must match before closing the invoice.
What confirms that Treasury has received and accepted the approved invoices from AP?

summary: AP reviews and records vendor invoices, obtains manager review and client approval, and hands approved items to Treasury. Queried or rejected invoices stay out of the batch and payment run. The invoice is closed only after the specified records and bank evidence match. The initiating event and accountable role remain open.
